lines: By that effort the examined real is reverently won;
since its freedom is everywhere — unmade, not done.
sanskrit_cite: labhate tatprayatnena parīkṣyaṃ tattvam ādarāt | yataḥ svatantratā tasya sarvatreyam akṛtrimā

lines: Not as impeller of wishing does it run its race —
but from self-power's touch, the person becomes like that.
sanskrit_cite: na hīcchānodanasyāyam prerakatvena vartate | api tv ātmabalasparśāt puruṣas tatsamo bhavet

lines: Of the impure, desiring things to be done —
when agitation dissolves, the supreme state is won.
sanskrit_cite: nijāśuddhyāsamarthasya kartavyeṣv abhilāṣiṇaḥ | yadā kṣobhaḥ pralīyeta tadā syāt paramam padam

lines: all he desires he knows and does.
sanskrit_cite: tadāsyākṛtrimo dharmo jñatvakartṛtvalakṣaṇah | yatas tadepsitaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti ca karoti ca

lines: Regarding his own nature as the presider, he abides as if smiling —
whence, for him, this evil course?
sanskrit_cite: tam adhiṣṭhātṛbhāvena svabhāvam avalokayan | smayamāna ivāste yas tasyeyaṃ kusṛtiḥ kutaḥ

lines: Non-being goes to be-becomeness, and undelusion is not there;
since, from contact's application — then thus was certainty.
sanskrit_cite: nābhāvo bhāvyatām eti na ca tatrāsty amūḍhatā | yato 'bhiyogasaṃsparśāt tadāsid iti niścayah

lines: Hence the made-thing is known as ever like deep sleep;
but not as thus-remembered can that reality attain.
sanskrit_cite: atas tatkṛtrimaṃ jñeyaṃ sauṣuptapadavat sadā | na tv evaṃ smaryamāṇatvaṃ tat tattvam pratipadyate
